_comment: Maps DESIGN.md §2.6's 29-piece debris catalogue onto the licensed sprite pack in
assets/asteroid and Space junks/. The catalogue ids are the authority — this file
only says which picture goes with which id, and carries no mass, value or altitude.
Those live in the game config, because §4.3 cut size classes: every piece is one slot
and differs only in mass and value, so a sprite can never change what a piece is worth.
Assignments were made by eye from the pack's own contact sheets and are recorded here
rather than derived at runtime, so a sprite that reads wrong can be corrected in one
The file naming is the pack's own, including its 'Aestroid' typo. Left as shipped so
the tree still matches the archive it came from.
_module_note: armstrongs_module is the win condition (§2.6) and 34 is a placeholder, not a choice.
It needs Apollo-era hardware that reads as OLDER than everything else in the field,
plus three condition states — pristine, damaged, scrap — reusing the shield's ablation
pattern, and a separate off-palette glint sprite for the overhead marker. No pack here
supplies any of that; change-log row `art-open-items` expects it to be commissioned.
_unused: 57 of the pack's 87 sprites are unassigned. Deliberate: they are the pool for size and
silhouette variety within a piece type, and for the asteroid-rather-than-wreckage look
if the band ever wants some. Do not delete them to satisfy a 'assets/ carries only what
the game uses' check without first deciding that question.
